outputs.location: Data availability section (immediately after Materials and Methods)
outputs.issues: The section exists and gives repository accession numbers (GSE240635 SuperSeries; GSE240633 RNA‑seq; GSE240632 ATAC‑seq) and refers to Dataset EV1 / Table EV1 / Table EV2, but it does not follow the required bullet format. Problems: (1) items are not listed as individual bullets with data type, repository name, DOI/accession, and a resolvable link; (2) several resources (Dataset EV1, Table EV1, Table EV2, and "source data") lack a repository accession or DOI and no resolvable URL is provided; (3) no explicit clickable/resolvable links are given for the GEO accessions or other datasets. Please reformat into bullets and include data type, repository, accession/DOI and a resolvable link for each dataset.
